notes.title: The Forgotten Ward Is Opening
notes.notes:
[p][b]You awaken in a place you’ve already been.[/b][/p][p]The walls hum. The halls stretch.
And something in the dark… remembers you.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🩸 [b]Ashes of the Damned: The Forgotten Ward[/b] is a slow-burn, psychological horror game about guilt, memory, and the things that never stay buried.[/p][p]There’s no combat. No map. Just a flashlight, fragments of truth, and a ward that always wanted you back.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔍 [b]Wishlist Now on Steam[/b]
Every wishlist helps a solo developer keep this project alive.[/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 [b]Join the Community[/b]
We’ve opened the Discord - meet other patients, get dev updates, or just leave something behind in the ward.
[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/EbW7suVmgS"]https://discord.gg/EbW7suVmgS[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]The ward is open.
We’ll be waiting.[/p]
